description: 国王印度防御——封闭中心后侧翼突破，23步练习注释

intro.popup: 国王印度练习：中心被封锁后，双方的战场转移到两翼——观察侧翼突破的力量！
intro.popup_en: King's Indian practice: Once the center is locked, both sides shift their attention to the wings. Watch the power of a flank break!

outro.popup: 中心封闭时，谁先在侧翼打开局面，谁就掌握主动权。
outro.popup_en: When the center is closed, the side that opens play on a wing first can seize the initiative.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 1.d4 — 白方先占 d4！
与 e4 开局不同，1.d4 建立 d 线中心。这是封闭性开局的起点，双方将争夺中心空间而非直接激战。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 1.d4 - White occupies d4!
Unlike 1.e4, this establishes a center with the d-pawn and begins a more closed opening, where the sides contest space before direct clashes occur.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 1...Nf6 — 黑马出动！不占中心！
黑方用马而非兵来应对，这是「超现代」开局思路：不直接占中心，而是用子力控制中心格。注意黑方此刻没有推兵占 d5！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 1...Nf6 - Black develops without occupying the center!
This is a hypermodern approach: use pieces to control central squares instead of occupying them with pawns. Black has not played ...d5.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 2.c4 — 白方再推 c4！空间扩张！
c4 与 d4 配合，白方现在控制了 d5 和 e5 两个关键格，黑方的兵很难进入这些格子。白方在建立广阔的中心控制区。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 2.c4 - White expands with another pawn!
Together with d4, c4 controls the key squares d5 and e5, making it harder for Black's pawns to occupy them. White builds a broad central presence.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 2...g6 — 黑方抢先部署象！
g6 准备把象发展到 g7——g7 的象将控制长对角线（a1-h8），对白方中心形成压力。这是印度防御的标志布局！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 2...g6 - Black prepares to fianchetto the bishop!
The bishop on g7 will control the long a1-h8 diagonal and put pressure on White's center, a hallmark of the Indian defenses.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 3.Nc3 — 白马出动占据中心！
c3 马支撑 d4 和 e4，准备 e4 的推进。白方正在建立一个由 d4+c4+e4 组成的「三兵中心」。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 3.Nc3 - White develops a knight toward the center!
The knight supports d4 and e4, preparing the e-pawn advance. White aims for a three-pawn center with c4, d4, and e4.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 3...Bg7 — 印度象登场！龙象！
黑象来到 g7，俗称「龙象」，控制长对角线。这个象虽然暂时被 d4 兵挡住，一旦中心格局变化，它将成为威力巨大的长程武器！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 3...Bg7 - The fianchettoed bishop takes aim!
The bishop controls the long diagonal. Although White's d4-pawn currently blocks it, the bishop may become powerful if the central structure changes.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 4.e4 — 白方建立三兵中心！
e4 加入，白方现在拥有 c4+d4+e4 的三兵中心，控制棋盘中心区域的所有关键格。这是理论上白方在国王印度防御中能达到的最强中心阵型！
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 4.e4 - White establishes the three-pawn center!
With pawns on c4, d4, and e4, White controls key central squares and claims a broad center against the King's Indian.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 4...d6 — 黑方支撑未来的 e5！
d6 为 e5 的推进铺垫——这是国王印度防御的典型结构。黑方接受中心落后，但在等待反击的时机。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 4...d6 - Black prepares ...e5!
This is a typical King's Indian structure. Black allows White to occupy more space while preparing a later counterattack.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 5.Nf3 — 白方完成子力发展！
f3 马出动，支撑 d4，准备易位。白方子力发展完成，即将进入稳固的中局阵势。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 5.Nf3 - White develops and supports d4!
The knight prepares to castle, and White is close to completing development before settling into a solid middlegame setup.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 5...O-O — 黑方王翼易位！
黑方先易位，王到 g8 处于看似安全的位置——但注意，接下来黑方要在王翼发动兵攻！这需要精确判断王安全与进攻之间的平衡。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 5...O-O - Black castles kingside!
The king reaches apparent safety on g8, but Black plans a kingside pawn attack. Balancing king safety with attacking chances will be important.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 6.Be2 — 白方稳健发展！
象来到 e2，白方准备易位。与激进的 Bc4 不同，Be2 是古典变例，强调稳固而非速攻。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 6.Be2 - White develops solidly!
The bishop moves to e2 and White prepares to castle. Unlike the more aggressive Bc4, this is a classical, steady setup.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 6...e5 — 黑方宣布封锁中心！
黑方推 e5，挑战白方中心。现在关键时刻到来——白方如何应对？
❓ 白方如果 dxe5 打开中心，黑方 dxe5，双方对等。
✅ 白方如果 d5，中心封锁，双方各奔侧翼！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 6...e5 - Black challenges and seeks to close the center!
White now faces a key choice:
❓ After dxe5 dxe5, the center opens and the position becomes balanced.
✅ After d5, the center locks and both sides can attack on the wings.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 7.d5 — 白方封锁中心！战略决定！
白方推 d5，接受封闭中心！现在双方的中心兵链固定，不再有直接中心冲突。
📍 从这一步开始，双方转向侧翼！
• 白方计划：后翼（c5 突破）
• 黑方计划：王翼（f5-g5 突破）
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 7.d5 - White locks the center!
The central pawn chains become fixed, ending the direct central clash.
📍 Now both sides turn to the wings:
• White seeks a queenside break with c5.
• Black plans a kingside attack with ...f5 and ...g5.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 7...Nbd7 — 黑马发展，准备侧翼！
b8 马跳到 d7，为后续的 Nf8-Nh7-f5 做准备。黑方的所有棋子都在向王翼进攻路线集中！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 7...Nbd7 - Black reroutes the knight for the flank attack!
The b8-knight heads to d7 and may continue via f8 and h7 toward f5. Black is gathering pieces for a kingside offensive.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 8.Bg5 — 白象骚扰！
白象出动，钉住 f6 马或准备交换，削弱黑方的王翼防守力量。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 8.Bg5 - White creates pressure!
The bishop pins the f6-knight or may exchange it, potentially weakening Black's kingside defenses.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 8...h6 — 赶走白象！
h6 驱逐 g5 象，强迫白象表态。黑方不愿意让白象长期骚扰 f6 马。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 8...h6 - Black challenges the bishop!
The pawn attacks the bishop and asks it to choose a square. Black does not want it to keep pressuring the f6-knight.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 9.Bh4 — 象退 h4，持续施压！
象退到 h4，钉住 f6 马，等待黑方进一步暴露。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 9.Bh4 - The bishop retreats while maintaining pressure!
It remains aimed at the f6-knight and waits for Black to commit further.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 9...g5 — 王翼兵攻开始！
黑方推 g5，直接攻击 h4 象，同时开始王翼兵链推进！这正是国王印度防御的核心策略——封闭中心后的侧翼突破。
⚡ 注意：黑王就在 g8，这需要很大的勇气和精确计算！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 9...g5 - Black launches the kingside pawn attack!
The pawn attacks the bishop on h4 and begins a kingside advance, a core King's Indian plan after the center closes.
⚡ Black's king is on g8, so this requires careful calculation.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 10.Bg3 — 象再退 g3，坚守阵地！
白象退 g3，保持对黑方王翼的压力，同时观察黑方下一步动作。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 10.Bg3 - The bishop retreats again and holds its ground!
White keeps pressure on the kingside and waits to see how Black continues.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 10...Nh5 — 黑马直扑 g3 象！
黑马跳到 h5，直接攻击 g3 象！若白象被迫离开，f4 格就成了黑方兵推进的跳板。
这是国王印度防御中「消灭对方象」再侧翼突破的经典手法！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 10...Nh5 - Black attacks the bishop on g3!
If the bishop moves, f4 may become a useful launch square for Black's pawns.
This is a classic King's Indian idea: exchange a defender before breaking on the wing.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 11.h4 — 白方在后翼反击！
白方推 h4，试图打乱黑方的王翼节奏，同时拆解黑方的兵链。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 11.h4 - White counterattacks on the wing!
The pawn advance tries to disrupt Black's kingside rhythm and break up the pawn chain.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 11...Nxg3 — 黑马吃象！打开 f 线！
黑马吃掉 g3 象，打开了 f 线！白方必须用 f 兵吃回，f 线的结构将发生变化，黑方的 f 兵推进路线更加畅通。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 11...Nxg3 - Black captures the bishop and opens the f-file!
White is likely to recapture with the f-pawn, changing the file structure and clearing a route for Black's f-pawn advance.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 12.fxg3 — f 兵吃 g3，f 线打开！
白方 f2 兵吃 g3，f 线部分打开。

国王印度防御展示了深刻的棋理：中心不是终点，而是侧翼突破的基础。 白方建立了看似强大的三兵中心，却被黑方用王翼兵攻巧妙破解。封闭中心后，谁的侧翼突破更快，谁就握有主动权！
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 12.fxg3 - White recaptures and opens the f-file!
The f-pawn captures on g3, partly opening the file.

The King's Indian illustrates a key idea: the center is not the final goal; it can be a platform for a flank break. White built a large center, while Black seeks counterplay on the kingside. Once the center is closed, the faster flank attack may seize the initiative.
